title: Mayor & Council | City of Blue Springs, MO - Official Website
content: # Mayor & Council. The city of Blue Springs has a Mayor-Council-Administrator form of government as set forth in the Home Rule City Charter. ## City Council. The City Council it comprised of 6 members, 2 from each of the 3 districts. ## Mayor. The executive power in the City shall be vested in a Mayor who shall be recognized as the head of the City for all legal and ceremonial purposes and by the Governor of Missouri for all purposes of military law. As a member of the City Council, the Mayor shall have all powers, rights, privileges, duties, and responsibilities of a member of the City Council, including the right to vote on questions. title: Kinston Mayor and City Council | Kinston, NC
content: # Kinston Mayor and City Council. ## About the Mayor and City Council. The Kinston City Council is comprised of 5 Councilmembers and the Mayor. The Mayor leads all meetings of the City Council. The Mayor appoints a Mayor Pro Tem from the elected City Councilmembers. You can review the Kinston City Council Reference Manual to learn more about the Council's role in City operations. The City Council appoints the City Manager, City Attorney and the City Clerk. The City Clerk is the custodian of the official records for the City Council and serves as liaison between the Mayor, City Councilmembers and the public. Those wishing to reach the Mayor and City Councilmembers, should contact the City Clerk. The City Council meetings are broadcast live on the Government Access Channel for citizens who have their cable subscription with Suddenlink, broadcast Live on the City of Kinston Facebook page, and may be streamed from the Agenda and Minutes page.
